about: BN5's MeddySoul (Team ProtoMan's Soul 6) in both engines: its flag entry written in BN5's ROM copy and set (souls5), the Souls installed in BN6's engine holding it (souls6 bit 23), a deck of Recov10 * in both (BN5's 107, BN6's 154: Recovery, MeddySoul's kind), the first Custom screen's first chip picked and given up, UNITE and OK; it unites as the first turn starts (no passive: BN5's ready and collision tables name none for form 6). The spec ends at t523, before a second Custom screen: there BN5's puts MeddySoul's two capsules on the Soul button (its elements 8 and 9, BN5's 0x08023CF4), which BN6's Custom screen does not show yet (the Souls' button, ColonelSoul's, made his and SearchSoul's: a follow-up). CanGard V1 at (6,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with 2000 HP, kept from harm (docs/game/team-protoman.md, unit 8).
subject: megaman
expect_why: BN5's own course: MeddySoul united from t1 (Meddy's AI index 6), its turns 3, its used bit 0x40, UNITE chosen on the first screen; MegaMan never hit (safe).
